content: Dietary management for diabetes mellitus involves specific nutritional strategies to help regulate blood sugar levels and maintain overall health. These include: 1. Reducing the consumption of foods that are high in sugar to prevent rapid spikes in blood glucose levels. 2. Consuming smaller portions of food and distributing meals evenly throughout the day to maintain stable blood sugar levels. 3. Monitoring the timing and quantity of carbohydrate intake to ensure proper glycemic control. 4. Incorporating a diverse range of whole-grain foods, fruits, and vegetables into the daily diet to provide essential nutrients and fiber. 5. Reducing the intake of dietary fats, particularly saturated and trans fats, to support cardiovascular health. 6. Limiting alcohol consumption, as it can interfere with blood sugar regulation and overall metabolic health. 7. Minimizing the use of salt to help manage blood pressure and reduce the risk of cardiovascular complications.
